question: People living in rural and regional areas can face additional barriers to healthcare, including long travel distances, shortages of specialist services and difficulties accessing diagnostic facilities. 1.
What EU programmes can support Member States in developing innovative healthcare delivery models, including telemedicine and improved access to specialist diagnostics in underserved rural areas?

Will the Commission improve the collection and comparison of data on regional healthcare inequalities, including access to specialist care and diagnostic services, to help identify and address persistent gaps?
